content:
name: course-catalog-browser

on:
  pull_request:
    paths:
      - catalog.html
      - catalog/**
      - src/course-catalog*.mjs
      - tools/build-course-catalog.mjs
      - tools/check_course_catalog_browser.mjs
      - courses/*.json
      - demo.html
      - src/deck*.mjs
      - src/app.mjs
      - .github/workflows/catalog-browser.yml
  push:
    branches: [main]
    paths:
      - catalog.html
      - catalog/**
      - src/course-catalog*.mjs
      - tools/build-course-catalog.mjs
      - tools/check_course_catalog_browser.mjs
      - courses/*.json
      - demo.html
      - src/deck*.mjs
      - src/app.mjs
      - .github/workflows/catalog-browser.yml

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: ${{ github.workflow }}-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  real-browser:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      # Same pinned action identities as the existing test.yml; its bytes stay unchanged.
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: "22"
      - name: Check maintained receiver syntax
        run: node --check tools/check_course_catalog_browser.mjs
      - name: Verify the committed standalone catalog
        run: |
          node tools/build-course-catalog.mjs --check
          git diff --exit-code -- catalog.html
      - name: Receive catalog downloads and learner handoff in installed Chrome
        run: |
          chrome_bin="$(command -v google-chrome)"
          "$chrome_bin" --version
          node tools/check_course_catalog_browser.mjs --root "$GITHUB_WORKSPACE" --browser "$chrome_bin" --output "$RUNNER_TEMP/course-catalog-receiving" --emit-bundle

name: test

on:
  push:
    branches: [main]
  pull_request:

permissions:
  contents: read

jobs:
  node-test:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    steps:
      # Pinned to the live v4 tag tips (verified 2026-10-07).
      - uses: actions/checkout@11d5960a326750d5838078e36cf38b85af677262 # v4
      - uses: actions/setup-node@49933ea5288caeca8642d1e84afbd3f7d6820020 # v4
        with:
          node-version: "20"
      - name: run dependency-free unit/property tests
        run: node --test tests/*.test.mjs
      - name: verify demo.html is in sync with sources
        run: |
          cp demo.html /tmp/demo-before.html
          python3 tools/make_demo.py
          cmp /tmp/demo-before.html demo.html || { echo "demo.html is stale: run 'python3 tools/make_demo.py' and commit the result"; exit 1; }
